notes: Intervals are conformalized quantile regression intervals (0.05/0.95 LightGBM quantile heads, crossing-corrected, shifted by the finite-sample quantile of per-event max scores) around the dataset risk target (log10 Pc); they describe uncertainty of the dataset label, not every physical uncertainty of an encounter.
Coverage is reported empirically on evaluation events; no universal or subgroup guarantee is claimed.
Pc-only metrics isolate model skill from the deterministic distance rule.
Zero observed misses in a subset would not imply zero operational risk; see event-bootstrap intervals.
